# Theyyampattil Furniture GCC

> Theyyampattil Furniture designs and supplies bespoke furniture and custom interior solutions for homes and commercial spaces across the United Arab Emirates.

## Official website
- https://theyyampattilgcc.com/

## Main pages
- [About Theyyampattil](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/about/): Company history, craftsmanship and showroom information.
- [Furniture products](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/products/): Custom TV wall units, kitchens, walk-in closets, partitions, dressing rooms, bed panels and wall panels.
- [Furniture solutions and enquiry](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/store/furniture-solutions/): Bespoke furniture solutions and consultation enquiry.
- [Dubai showroom](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/showroom/luxury-furniture-dubai/): Furniture collections and showroom information for Dubai.
- [Sharjah showroom](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/showroom/custom-luxury-furniture-sharjah/): Custom furniture and showroom information for Sharjah.
- [Abu Dhabi showroom](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/showroom/luxury-furniture-abu-dhabi/): Furniture collections and showroom information for Abu Dhabi.
- [Blogs and design guides](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/blogs/): Furniture buying advice, interior design ideas and material guides.
- [Catalogs and downloads](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/resource/downloads/): Corporate profile and furniture catalog resources.
- [Contact](https://theyyampattilgcc.com/contact/): Contact details and enquiry options.

## Services and product categories
- Bespoke living room and bedroom furniture
- Custom TV wall units and wall panels
- Walk-in closets, wardrobes and dressing rooms
- Kitchen furniture and cabinetry
- Room partitions and modern doors
- Furniture design, measurement, manufacturing and installation

## Service area
The company serves customers across the United Arab Emirates, with showroom pages for Dubai, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. For current availability, delivery scope, pricing and project timelines, contact the company directly.
